summary_en: This Phase 4 study tests testosterone replacement therapy in men with low testosterone and low-risk prostate cancer who are on active surveillance. Participants self-inject 100 mg of testosterone cypionate once a week for 12 months. The record does not list a specific outcome measure; the stated purpose is to evaluate the safety of the therapy.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 4 evalúa la terapia de reemplazo de testosterona en hombres con niveles bajos de testosterona y cáncer de próstata de bajo riesgo que están en vigilancia activa. Los participantes se inyectan por sí mismos 100 mg de cipionato de testosterona una vez por semana durante 12 meses. El registro no indica una medida de resultado específica; el propósito declarado es evaluar la seguridad de la terapia.
who_for: Newly diagnosed low-risk prostate cancer, or low-risk prostate cancer on active surveillance.
Two testosterone levels below 350 ng/dL, taken before 10am, 24 hours to 90 days apart.
Symptoms of low testosterone (Aging Male's Symptoms score above 27).
Able to obtain the medication and give written informed consent.
not_for: Gleason score 7 (Grade Group 2) or higher on biopsy.
Current testosterone replacement therapy, or use within the past year.
T3 or T4 disease, history of breast cancer, or unstable angina.
